commands.name: hook-denies-bare-create-exit-2
commands.run: printf '%s' '{"tool_name":"Bash","tool_input":{"command":"herdr worktree create --branch x"}}' | claude/hooks/herdr_worktree_guard.py 2>/dev/null; test $? -eq 2

commands.name: template-registers-hook-after-push-guard
commands.run: python3 -c "import json,sys; g=[e for e in json.load(open('claude/settings.json.tmpl'))['hooks']['PreToolUse'] if e.get('matcher')=='Bash']; c=[h['command'] for e in g for h in e['hooks']]; sys.exit(0 if c[-2:]==['~/.claude/hooks/push_guard.py','~/.claude/hooks/herdr_worktree_guard.py'] else 1)"
